title: Five Israelis wounded and two suspected Palestinian attackers killed in West Bank shooting
english: Two suspected Palestinian gunmen were killed by Israeli security forces after wounding five Israelis during a shooting at a checkpoint near Hebron in the West Bank. Following the incident, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered a military lockdown of the region, and authorities recovered significant ammunition from the attackers' vehicle. This violent event takes place amid heightened regional tensions and just days before Israel's scheduled general election.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ሄብሮን ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የፍተሻ ጣቢያ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ አምስት እስራኤላውያን ቆስለዋል፣ ሁለት የፍልስጤም ተጠርጣሪዎችም በእስራኤል የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ተገድለዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለክልሉ አጠቃላይ የእንቅስቃሴ ገደብ እንዲጣል ትእዛዝ የሰጡ ሲሆን፣ የጸጥታ ኃይሎችም በተጠርጣሪዎቹ መኪና ውስጥ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ጥይት አግኝተዋል። ይህ ግጭት የተከሰተው በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት ከፍተኛ በሆነበት እና የእስራኤል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ሊካሄድ ጥቂት ቀናት ብቻ በቀሩበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Naannoo West Bank magaalaa Hebronitti argamutti, namoonni lama kanneen hidhattoota Falasxiin ta'an shakkaman, waraana Israa'el irratti dhukaasa bananii booda humnoota nageenyaatiin ajjeefamaniiru; dhukaasa kanaanis Israa'eloonni shan madaa'aniiru. Muummichi Ministaraa Benyaamin Neetanyaahu naannichatti labsii daangaa cufuu kan labsan yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni kunneen konkolaataa isaanii keessatti rasaasa baay'ee qabachuu isaanii mootummaan beeksiseera. Rakkoon kun kan uumame waraqaan filannoo Israa'el dhihaachuu fi naannichatti walitti bu'iinsi cimaan jiraachuu isaa hordofee dha.

title: Cyprus police open investigation into financial affairs of Roman Abramovich
english: Cypriot authorities have launched an investigation into the financial activities of billionaire Roman Abramovich following allegations of tax evasion and document falsification. The inquiry follows reports from the BBC and other investigative journalists suggesting that the accounting firm Deloitte helped hide hundreds of millions of dollars in assets. While Abramovich’s legal team denies any wrongdoing, the police are now working to determine if criminal actions occurred through offshore companies.
amharic: የቆጵሮስ ፖሊስ የቢሊየነሩን የሮማን አብራሞቪች የፋይናንስ እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የቢቢሲ እና ሌሎች ጋዜጠኞች የሂሳብ አያያዝ ድርጅቱ ዲሎይት አብራሞቪች ሀብቱን እንዲደብቅ እና ግብር እንዲያሸሽ እንደረዳው ከዘገቡ በኋላ ነው። አብራሞቪች ምንም አይነት ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት እንዳልፈፀመ ቢክድም፣ ባለስልጣናት በውጭ ሀገራት በሚገኙ ኩባንያዎች በኩል የተፈፀሙ የወንጀል ድርጊቶች መኖራቸውን ለማረጋገጥ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Poolisiin Qopiroos qabeenyaa fi hojiiwwan faayinaansii biiliyeenera Rooman Abraamooviich irratti qorannoo jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Qorannoon kun kan jalqabame, dhaabbanni herregaa Deelooyit qabeenya Abraamooviich dhoksuu fi gibira irraa akka fagaatu gargaareera jedhamee gabaasoota BBC fi qorattoota biraatiin himannaan erga dhiyaatee booda. Abraamooviich himannaa kana kan haalu yoo ta'u, abbootiin taayitaa garuu dhaabbilee biyya alaa keessatti socho'an kanaan yakki raawwatamuu isaa mirkaneessuuf qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
english: Typhoon Champi has severely disrupted travel and public life in Taiwan, leading to hundreds of flight cancellations and the closure of schools, offices, and the stock exchange. The powerful storm has already caused one death and over 170 injuries, with many residents forced to evacuate their homes. While the storm is expected to pass the island without making direct landfall, it is still expected to dump extreme rainfall and bring dangerous winds across the region.
amharic: ኃይለኛው የቻምፒ ታይፎን የታይዋንን የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት በማስተጓጎል በብዙ መቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ እና ትምህርት ቤቶች፣ ቢሮዎች እና የአክሲዮን ገበያው እንዲዘጉ አድርጓል። አውሎ ነፋሱ እስካሁን የአንድ ሰው ህይወት ሲቀጥፍ ከ170 በላይ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል፣ በርካታ ነዋሪዎችም ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተገደዋል። አውሎ ነፋሱ በቀጥታ ደሴቲቱን ባይመታም፣ ከፍተኛ ዝናብ እና አደገኛ ነፋስ እንደሚያስከትል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Champi jedhamu kan Taiwan keessatti rakkoo guddaa uume yoo ta'u, kunis balaliiwwan hedduu akka haaqamaniifi manneen barnootaa, waajjiraaleefi gabaan aksiyoonaa akka cufaman taasiseera. Obomboleettiin cimaan kun lubbuu nama tokkoo galaafatee, namoota 171 ol irratti miidhaa geessiseera, akkasumas namoonni kuma tokko ol qe'ee isaaniirraa godaananiiru. Obomboleettiin kun biyyattii kallattiin rukuta jedhamee kan hin eegamne ta'us, rooba cimaafi bubbee baay'ee geessisuun isaa ni tilmaamama.

title: New electronics reach Iran, but prices soar as gov’t fees, US sanctions hit
english: Despite international sanctions and restricted trade routes, the latest electronic devices are still reaching consumers in Iran. However, these goods are arriving through complicated smuggling networks, which significantly inflates the cost for local buyers. Consequently, while technology remains available, the combined impact of government fees and trade barriers makes them unaffordable for many Iranians.
amharic: በአለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች እና በተገደበ የንግድ መስመሮች ምክንያት፣ አዳዲስ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሳሪያዎች ወደ ኢራን ቢገቡም በከፍተኛ ዋጋ እየተሸጡ ነው። እነዚህ እቃዎች ወደ ሀገር ውስጥ የሚገቡት በተወሳሰቡ የኮንትሮባንድ መንገዶች አማካኝነት በመሆኑ ለገዢዎች ከፍተኛ ወጪ ያስከትላል። በውጤቱም፣ ቴክኖሎጂው በገበያ ላይ ቢገኝም፣ በመንግስት ቀረጥ እና በንግድ እገዳዎች የተነሳ ለብዙ ኢራናውያን የመግዛት አቅም ከባድ ሆኗል።
oromo: Maallaqa biyyoota alaa fi daangaa daldalaan walqabatee rakkoon jiraatus, meeshaaleen elektirooniksii haaraa Iran keessatti argamuun isaanii itti fufeera. Haa ta'u malee, meeshaaleen kun gara biyyatti kan galan karaa seeraan alaa fi xaxamaa ta'een waan ta'eef, gatiin isaanii baay'ee qaaliidha. Bu'aa kanaatiin, teknolojichi gabaa keessatti kan argamu ta'us, gibira mootummaa fi gufuu daldalaa irraa kan ka'e namoonni hedduun bitachuu hin danda'an.

title: Serbia’s snap election: What’s at stake and can students unseat Vucic?
english: Serbia is holding a snap parliamentary election on October 25 that serves as a critical test for President Aleksandar Vucic’s long-standing leadership. The vote follows a nationwide protest movement led by students, sparked by public outrage over a deadly train station collapse in 2024. A new student-backed political group is now challenging the ruling party, focusing their campaign on fighting corruption and strengthening government accountability.
amharic: ሰርቢያ በጥቅምት 25 ቀን በሚካሄድ ቀደም ብሎ በተጠራ ፓርላማዊ ምርጫ ወሳኝ ምዕራፍ ላይ ትገኛለች። ምርጫው ለፕሬዚዳንት አሌክሳንደር ቩቺች የረጅም ጊዜ ስልጣን ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በ2024 በባቡር ጣቢያ የደረሰውን አሳዛኝ አደጋ ተከትሎ በተማሪዎች የተጀመረው ተቃውሞ ውጤት ነው። አሁን በአዲስ የተቋቋመው የተማሪዎች ቡድን ሙስናን በመዋጋት እና የመንግስትን ተጠያቂነት በማስፈን ገዥውን ፓርቲ ለመገዳደር እየሞከረ ነው።
oromo: Serbiyaan filannoo paarlaamaa hatattamaa sadaasa 25 gaggeessuuf qophiirra jirti; kunis dursaa Aleksaandar Vuuchichiif qormaata guddaa ta'eera. Filannoon kun sochii mormii barattootaan durfamuufi balaa gaaraa sana irratti mudateen booda dhalateen wal qabata. Gareen barattootaa haaraan kunis, malaammaltummaa irratti xiyyeeffachuufi itti gaafatamummaa mootummaa cimsuun paartii aangoo irra jiru dura dhaabbachaa jira.

title: NBA’s Irving praises Al-Shaair’s ‘selfless act’ after Hind Rajab fine paid
english: NBA star Kyrie Irving recently paid an NFL fine of nearly $12,000 imposed on football player Azeez Al-Shaair. Al-Shaair was penalized for displaying the name of Hind Rajab, a Palestinian child killed in Gaza, during a game. Irving described the gesture as a selfless act of solidarity and emphasized the importance of speaking out for those who have lost their lives in the conflict.
amharic: የኤንቢኤ ኮከብ ካይሪ ኢርቪንግ በቅርቡ የአሜሪካ እግር ኳስ ተጫዋች ለሆነው አዚዝ አል-ሻኢር የተጣለበትን የ12,000 ዶላር ቅጣት ከፍሏል። አል-ሻኢር የተቀጣው በጋዛ በጦርነት ለተገደለችው ህጻን ሂንድ ራጃብ ስም በመታሰቢያነት በመጠቀሙ ነው። ኢርቪንግ ይህንን ድርጊት የነጻነት እና የአብሮነት መግለጫ በማለት በማድነቅ፣ በጦርነቱ ህይወታቸውን ላጡ ንጹሃን ድምጽ መሆን አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Leeyyuun taphataa kubbaa sagalee (NBA) Kyrie Irving, adabbii maallaqa dolaara 12,000 ol ta'u kan taphataa kubbaa miillaa Azeez Al-Shaair irra ga'e kaffaleera. Al-Shaair kan adabame maqaa mucayyoo Falasxiin Hind Rajab jedhamtuu fi waraana Gaazaa keessatti ajjeefamte qoma isaa irratti barreessuun isaa fi. Irving gocha kana akka gocha tokkummaa fi of-kenninsaatti ilaaluun, namoota waraana kanaan miidhamanif sagalee ta'uun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: What role does the military play in Israeli schools?
english: The Israeli military plays a significant role in the daily lives of teenagers by integrating itself directly into the school system. Educational environments are used to prepare students for their future service in the armed forces. This ongoing influence shapes the experiences and perspectives of young people long before they officially enlist.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ በመሳተፍ የተማሪዎችን የዕለት ተዕለት ሕይወት ይቀርጻል። በትምህርት ተቋማት ውስጥ የሚሰጠው ስልጠና ወጣቶችን ለወደፊት ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ለማዘጋጀት ታስቦ የሚከናወን ነው። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው ተጽዕኖ ወጣቶች በይፋ ከመመልመላቸው በፊትም እንኳን ወታደራዊ አመለካከትን እንዲላበሱ ያደርጋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el mana barnootaa keessatti hirmaannaa cimaa qabaachuun jireenya dargaggootaa irratti dhiibbaa uuma. Manneen barnootaa barattoota gara fuulduraatti tajaajila waraanaaf akka qophaa'an gargaaruuf gosa barnootaa adda addaa fayyadamu. Dhiibbaan kun dargaggoonni osoo seeraan waraana hin seenin dura ilaalcha waraanaa akka horatan taasisa.

title: Pulaku: The two faces of Nigeria’s vigilantes
english: In Nigeria's Adamawa State, a Fulani-led vigilante group known as Pulaku is credited with fighting kidnapping, yet it faces serious accusations of torture and human rights abuses. While the group aims to improve security, victims have reported being abducted, intimidated, and held in dangerous conditions by these self-appointed law enforcers. This situation highlights the complex reality of relying on informal militias to maintain order, as their methods often blur the line between protection and criminal activity.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ አዳማዋ ግዛት የሚንቀሳቀሰው 'ፑላኩ' የተሰኘው የፉላኒ ታጣቂ ቡድን ወንጀለኞችን በመቆጣጠር ረገድ ሚና ቢኖረውም፣ አሰቃቂ ድርጊቶችን እና የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን በመፈጸም ይከሰሳል። ቡድኑ የጸጥታ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት የሚንቀሳቀስ ቢሆንም፣ በቡድኑ አባላት ስለሚፈጸሙ እገታዎችና ማስፈራሪያዎች የሚሰሙት ቅሬታዎች አሳሳቢ ሆነዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ ሕገወጥ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን በጸጥታ ስራ ውስጥ ማሳተፍ ለህብረተሰቡ ደህንነት ያለው ተጽዕኖ ምን ያህል አደገኛ እንደሆነ ያሳያል።
oromo: Naayijeeriya naannoo Adaamaawaatti gareen 'Pulaaku' jedhamu kan gosa Fulaanii irraa ijaarame, hattootaa fi buttoota ittisuuf kan gargaaru ta'us, dararaa fi miidhaa mirga namoomaa irratti raawwachuun himatama. Gareen kun nageenya buusuuf kan yaalu ta'us, namoonni ijoollee fi maatii isaanii irraa butamuun akkasumas sodaachifamuun isaanii gabaasameera. Haalli kun gareewwan ofiin ijaaran nageenya eegsisuuf fayyadamuu fi gochi isaanii kan seeraan ala ta'ee fi miidhaa kan geessisu ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: ‘Hereness’: What the forgotten history of Jewish anti-Zionism can teach us today
english: The British Green Party is facing political controversy after declaring Zionism to be racism, leading Prime Minister Andy Burnham to reject a coalition with them over concerns of antisemitism. While Zionism is often treated as synonymous with Jewish identity, many Jewish people—particularly younger generations—are increasingly identifying as anti-Zionist. This shift reflects a resurgence of interest in historical movements like the Jewish Labour Bund, which focused on Jewish cultural preservation within the countries where they lived rather than supporting a separate state.
amharic: የብሪታንያ አረንጓዴ ፓርቲ ጽዮናዊነት ዘረኝነት ነው በሚል መግለጫው የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ ውስጥ ገብቷል፣ ይህም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ ቡርንሃም ፀረ-ሴማዊነትን በመጥቀስ ጥምረት እንዲያቋርጡ አድርጓቸዋል። ጽዮናዊነት ብዙ ጊዜ ከአይሁድ ማንነት ጋር ተመሳሳይ እንደሆነ ቢታይም፣ ብዙ አይሁዳውያን በተለይም ወጣቱ ትውልድ ራሳቸውን እንደ ፀረ-ጽዮናዊ መግለጽ ጀምረዋል። ይህ ለውጥ አይሁዳውያን በኖሩባቸው አገራት ባህላቸውን ለመጠበቅ ይንቀሳቀሱ የነበሩ እንደ የአይሁድ የሠራተኛ ቡንድ ያሉ ታሪካዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች እንደገና መነሳታቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin Magariisaa (Green Party) biyya Ingiliiz ibsa 'Siyooniizimiin sanyii jibbummaadha' jedhu baasuun isaa mormii siyaasaa uumeera; kunis muummee ministiraa Andy Burnham walitti dhufeenya isaan waliin qaban akka morman taasiseera. Siyooniizimiin yeroo baay'ee akka amantii Yihuudotaa waliin walfakkaatutti kan ilaalamu ta'us, Yihuudonni hedduun, keessattuu dhalootni dargaggootaa, amantii kana mormuuf murteeffataniiru. Jijjiiramni kun sochiiwwan seenaa darban kan akka 'Jewish Labour Bund' kan Yihuudonni biyya itti jiraatan keessatti aadaa isaanii eeggachuu irratti xiyyeeffatan akka irra deebi'anii yaadan isaan taasiseera.

title: Israel prepares full West Bank lockdown after Hebron shooting
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered a full lockdown of the West Bank following a shooting attack in Hebron that left five soldiers wounded. Two Palestinian attackers were killed during the incident, which prompted the Israeli military to seal off the area and conduct raids in nearby towns. Additionally, authorities have closed the Ibrahimi Mosque, sparking condemnation from Palestinian officials over restricted religious access.
amharic: በሄብሮን ከተማ አምስት እስራኤላዊ ወታደሮችን ያቆሰለ የተኩስ አደጋን ተከትሎ፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በመላው ዌስት ባንክ አጠቃላይ የመዝጊያ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። በወታደሮቹ ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘሩት ሁለቱ ፍልስጤማውያን በተኩስ ልውውጥ ተገድለዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር አካባቢውን በመዝጋት በበርካታ አካባቢዎች ወረራዎችን ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የኢብራሂሚ መስጊድንም በመዝጋቱ የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaanhu, qabsoo hidhattootaa Hebron keessatti waraana shan miidhe booda, guutummaa daangaa West Bank akka cufamu ajajan. Hidhannoo sana keessatti namoonni lama kanneen waraana irratti dhukaasan ajjeefamaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el naannichatti duula gaggeessaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, masgiida Ibraahimii cufuun isaanii ammoo mormii fi balaaleffannaa warra Falasxiim kaaseera.

title: How Trump, Israel and big tech are driving Latin America to the right
english: Flavio Bolsonaro is currently challenging incumbent president Lula da Silva in Brazil's upcoming runoff election, signaling a potential right-wing shift across Latin America. This movement is heavily supported by evangelical groups, international alliances with Israel, and young social media influencers who leverage controversial content to gain political momentum. These far-right figures are using digital platforms and strong ideological messaging to reshape the region's political landscape.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዝዳንታዊ እጩ ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በምርጫው መወዳደራቸው በላቲን አሜሪካ የቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲካዊ አዝማሚያ እንዲስፋፋ እያደረገ ይገኛል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በወንጌላዊያን ቡድኖች፣ ከእስራኤል ጋር ባላቸው ጠንካራ ግንኙነት እና በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተፅእኖ ፈጣሪዎች ድጋፍ እየተጠናከረ ነው። እነዚህ ወጣት ፖለቲከኞች አወዛጋቢ የሆኑ ይዘቶችን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመጠቀም ሰፊ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት እና የክልሉን የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ለመቀየር እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Filaviyoo Bolsonaaroon filannoo duraa kan Biraazil keessatti Lula da Siilvaa wajjin dorgomaa jiru, kunis Latin Ameerikaa keessatti gara mirgaatti kan goru jijjiirama siyaasaa agarsiisa. Sochii kana kan gargaaraa jiran gareewwan amantii, hariiroo Israa'el wajjin qaban, akkasumas dargaggoota miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti beekamtii qaban kanneen qabiyyee mormisiisaa ta'e fayyadamanii siyaasa isaanii babal'isanidha. Dargaggoonni kunneen miidiyaa hawaasummaa fi ergaa cimaa fayyadamuun naannichaa keessatti jijjiirama siyaasaa fiduuf carraaqaa jiru.

title: ‘Turkey is a common enemy’: Pro-Israel network forms parliamentary groups in Greece and Cyprus
english: Influential pro-Israel lobbying groups are strengthening their political presence in Greece and Cyprus by establishing new parliamentary caucuses and holding high-level meetings with officials. These efforts aim to build security partnerships involving Israel and the United States while specifically framing Turkey as a shared regional adversary. The initiative underscores a strategic push to deepen Israel’s diplomatic and political influence across the Eastern Mediterranean.
amharic: ለእስራኤል ድጋፍ የሚሰጡ ሎቢ ቡድኖች በግሪክ እና በቆጵሮስ የፓርላማ ቡድኖችን በመመስረት በክልሉ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ እያጠናከሩ ይገኛሉ። ቡድኖቹ ከአሜሪካ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር የፀጥታ አጋርነት ለመፍጠር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ቱርክን እንደ የጋራ ጠላት በመፈረጅ አገራቱን በእስራኤል ዙሪያ ለማሰባሰብ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በእስራኤል እና በመካከለኛው ምሥራቅ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የፖለቲካ ግንኙነት ለመቀየር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gumiiwwan Israa’eliif falman kan ta’an, Giriikii fi Qophroos keessatti gareewwan paarlamaa hundeessuudhaan dhiibbaa siyaasaa isaanii cimsaa jiru. Gareewwan kun Israa’elii fi Ameerikaa waliin walitti dhufeenya nageenyaa uumuuf hojjachaa jiru; akkasumas Turkeen akka diina gamtaatti ibsuudhaan biyyoota kana Israa’el biratti walitti fiduuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun dhiibbaa diiplomaasii fi siyaasaa Israa’el baha Meditarraaneenii keessatti guddifachuuf kan taasifame dha.

title: Gaza bakeries forced to shut as Israel blocks flour shipments
english: Most commercial bakeries in Gaza have suspended operations after Israel blocked vital wheat flour shipments for the past ten days. This shortage has created a severe food crisis, leaving thousands of residents struggling to access bread and threatening widespread famine. Local officials are calling on the international community to intervene, warning that the lack of food supplies is causing a dangerous rise in malnutrition among vulnerable groups.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ አብዛኞቹ የንግድ ዳቦ መጋገሪያዎች እስራኤል የስንዴ ዱቄት እቃዎችን ለተከታታይ አስር ቀናት በማገዷ ምክንያት ስራቸውን አቁመዋል። ይህ የዱቄት እጥረት ከፍተኛ የምግብ ቀውስ የፈጠረ ሲሆን ነዋሪዎች ዳቦ ለማግኘት ሲቸገሩ እና የረሃብ አደጋም ተጋርጦባቸዋል። የጋዛ ባለስልጣናት በአስቸኳይ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ዓለም አቀፉን ማህበረሰብ የሚጠይቁ ሲሆን፣ የምግብ እጥረቱ በተለይም በህጻናት እና በዕድሜ የገፉ ሰዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጦት እያስከተለ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti booddeewwan daabboo gurguddoon hedduun Israa'el ergaa daakuu qamadii guyyoota kudhan darbanif dhorkattee booda hojii dhaabaniiru. Hanqinni daakuu kun rakkoo nyaataa cimaa uumeera; namoonni hedduun daabboo argachuuf rakkachaa jiru, akkasumas sodaan beelaa babal'achuu dabaleera. Qaamoleen mootummaa Gaza hawaasni addunyaa dhimma kana irratti akka tarkaanfii fudhatu gaafachaa jiru, akkasumas hanqinni nyaataa kun daa'immanii fi maanguddoota gidduutti rakkoo fayyaa cimaa uumaa akka jiru akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Nigeria and Kenya Ebola patients may have crossed paths at Uganda airport, officials say
english: Health authorities are investigating a potential link between two Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya that both passed through Uganda's Entebbe airport on October 3. Officials are examining whether the individuals could have come into contact or shared facilities while at the airport, though no direct connection has been confirmed yet. Experts are currently analyzing the movements of both patients to determine the source of their infections.
amharic: የጤና ባለሥልጣናት በጥቅምት 3 ቀን በኡጋንዳ ኤንቴቤ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በኩል ካለፉ ሁለት የኢቦላ ታማሚዎች መካከል ሊኖር የሚችል ግንኙነትን እያጣሩ ነው። ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው ውስጥ እያሉ በአካል ተገናኝተው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ወይም ተመሳሳይ አገልግሎቶችን ተጠቅመው ሊሆን እንደሚችል እየተመረመረ ይገኛል፣ ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን የተረጋገጠ ግንኙነት ባይኖርም። ባለሙያዎች የኢንፌክሽኑን ምንጭ ለመለየት የሁለቱንም ታማሚዎች እንቅስቃሴ በመከታተል ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa fayyaa dhukkubsattoota Ebola lama kan Naayijeeriyaa fi Keeniyaa irraa ta'anii fi Onkoloolessa 3tti buufata xiyyaaraa Entebbe kan Ugaandaa keessa darban gidduu hariiroo uumamuu danda'u qorachaa jiru. Namoonni kunneen buufata xiyyaaraa sanatti wal arguun ykn meeshaalee wal fakkaataa fayyadamuun danda'amuu isaanii kan qoratan ta'us, hanga ammaatti hariiroon kallattii tokko hin mirkanaa'e. Ogeeyyiin kunneen burqaa dhibee kanaa adda baasuuf sochiin dhukkubsattoota lamaanii xiyyeeffannoon hordofaa jiru.

title: Grenade exercise sparked deadly fire at Canada military base, army says
english: A training exercise involving live grenades at a Canadian military base in Alberta resulted in a catastrophic fire that killed four soldiers and injured nearly 40 others. Strong winds caused the flames to spread rapidly from the grenade range into a nearby area where troops were conducting combat drills. This tragedy occurred while the soldiers were preparing for an upcoming deployment to Latvia, marking one of the deadliest peacetime incidents in the history of the Canadian Armed Forces.
amharic: በአልበርታ ካናዳ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ የተደረገ የቀጥታ የእጅ ቦምብ ልምምድ፣ አራት ወታደሮችን የገደለ እና ወደ 40 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ያቆሰለ አስከፊ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። ኃይለኛ ነፋስ እሳቱን ከቦምብ መወርወሪያው ስፍራ ወደ ወታደሮች መለማመጃ ቦታ በማዛመቱ ጉዳቱ እንዲባባስ አድርጓል። ወታደሮቹ ወደ ላቲቪያ ለሚደረግ የሰላም ማስከበር ስምሪት በዝግጅት ላይ ሳሉ የደረሰው ይህ አደጋ፣ በካናዳ ጦር ሰራዊት ታሪክ ውስጥ ከታዩ በጣም አሳዛኝ የሰላም ጊዜ አደጋዎች አንዱ ሆኗል።
oromo: Buufata waraanaa Kaanaadaa kan Alberta keessatti leenjii boombii harkaatti fayyadamee godhameen, ibidda nama afran ajjeeseefi namoota 40 ol miidhe dhaqqabeera. Qilleensi cimaan ibidda kana bakka boombiin itti darbatamu irraa gara bakka waraanni leenjii itti taasiisaa jiruutti saffisiisuun miidhaan akka guddatu godheera. Waraanni kun gara Latviyaa deemuuf qophiirra osoo jiranii kan mudate kun, seenaa waraana Kaanaadaa keessatti balaa yeroo nagaa kanneen gurguddaa fi gaddisiisoo ta'an keessaa isa tokko dha.

title: Keeping Madhubala alive: The fight for Karachi’s captive elephants
english: Activists are fighting to save Madhubala, an African elephant currently living in captivity in Karachi, Pakistan, after her sister Noor Jehan passed away due to poor living conditions. These elephants were brought from Tanzania in 2009 and have struggled with medical issues caused by an inadequate environment. Concerned citizens and international organizations are now pressuring authorities to improve care or relocate the remaining elephants to a sanctuary, following the successful rescue of other captive elephants in the region.
amharic: በካራቺ ፓኪስታን የሚገኙ አክቲቪስቶች ማድሁባላ የተባለችውን የአፍሪካ ዝሆን በአግባቡ ባለመያዟና በጤና እክል ምክንያት ህይወቷ እንዳያልፍ እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ። ዝሆኖቹ እ.ኤ.አ በ2009 ከታንዛኒያ ወደ ፓኪስታን የመጡ ሲሆን፣ አሁን የሚገኙበት የእንስሳት መጠለያ ለጤንነታቸው ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ሌሎች ዝሆኖች ከዚህ ቀደም ወደ ተሻለ ቦታ እንዲዛወሩ የተደረገውን ጥረት በማስታወስ፣ አክቲቪስቶቹ የቀሩትን ዝሆኖች ወደ መጠለያ ቦታ እንዲቀየሩ መንግስትን እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Hojjetoonni mirga foonii fi lubbu qabeeyyii Paakistaan, magaalaa Kaaraachii keessatti arbi Maadhubaala jedhamtu kun akka hin duuneef qabsoo taasisaa jiru. Arbi kun fi obboleettiin ishee kanaan dura duute, bara 2009 biyya Taanzaniyaa irraa gara Paakistaanitti fiduun ishee ni yaadatama; taa'umsi isheen keessa jirtus fayyaaf ishee mijataa miti. Gargaartoonni fi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa, arboonni kunneen iddoo gaariitti akka jijjiiramanii fi kunuunsa barbaachisu akka argatan mootummaa gaafachaa jiru.

title: Israel arrests 36 Palestinians in the West Bank, attacks on farmers ramp up
english: Israeli forces recently conducted raids across the occupied West Bank, resulting in the arrest of 36 Palestinians. Simultaneously, there has been a significant increase in attacks by settlers and security forces against farmers during the critical olive harvest season. These incidents, which involve violence, crop theft, and the destruction of trees, are severely hindering the agricultural livelihoods of the Palestinian people.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባካሄደው ተከታታይ ወረራ 36 ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። በዚሁ ወቅት የወይራ ምርት በሚሰበሰብበት ወሳኝ ወቅት በአርሶ አደሮች ላይ የሚደርሰው ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የሰብል ዝርፊያን፣ የዛፎች ውድመትን እና በአርሶ አደሮች ላይ የሚፈጸም ጥቃትን የሚያካትቱ ሲሆን የፍልስጤማውያንን የኑሮ ምንጭ ለአደጋ እየዳረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa gara dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin namoota Palastiny 36 to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Yeroo kana keessatti, yeroo midhaan zaytun itti haamamu kanatti qonnaan bultoota irratti haleellaan raawwatamu dabalee jira. Haleellaan kunneen saaminsa midhaanii, mancaatii muka zaytunaa fi qonnaan bultoota irratti miidhaa geessisuudhaan jireenya fi bu'uura dinagdee uummata Palastiny irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa jira.

title: US tech stocks tumble as investors fret over AI spending
english: Major US technology stocks experienced a significant sell-off as investors expressed concern regarding the massive spending companies are dedicating to artificial intelligence. Large firms like Meta and Nvidia saw notable declines in share value after profit reports failed to meet expectations or signaled ballooning expenses. Additionally, the market was further impacted by rising global oil prices linked to ongoing regional tensions in the Middle East.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች አክሲዮኖች፣ ኩባንያዎች በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ላይ የሚያወጡት ከፍተኛ ወጪ አሳሳቢ በመሆኑ ዋጋቸው በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። እንደ ሜታ እና ኤንቪዲያ ያሉ ታዋቂ ድርጅቶች ትርፋቸው ከሚጠበቀው በታች በመውረዱ ወይም ወጪያቸው መጨመሩን በመግለጻቸው የአክሲዮን ዋጋቸው ወርዷል። ከዚህም በላይ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት የነዳጅ ዋጋን በመጨመሩ በገበያው ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gurguddoon qooda qabeenya teeknoolojii Ameerikaa gatiin isaanii kan hir'ate, abbootiin qabeenyaa baasii guddaa kampaniin guddina 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) irratti baasanirratti shakkii waan qabaniifi. Kampaniin gurguddoo akka Metaa fi Nvidia gatiin qooda qabeenya isaanii kan kufe, bu'aan isaanii kanneen eegamuun gadi ta'uu ykn baasiin isaanii daran dabaluu hordofee dha. Kana malees, walitti bu'iinsi naannoo Baha Giddu galeessaa gatii boba'aa waan dabaleef, kunis gabaa irratti dhiibbaa gad-aanaa geessiseera.

title: Venezuelans demand elections in first national protest in nearly two years
english: Thousands of Venezuelans recently held nationwide protests for the first time in two years, calling for the government to schedule free elections. Following the capture of former President Nicolas Maduro by U.S. forces, interim leader Delcy Rodriguez has remained in power without setting a firm date for a democratic vote. Opposition leader Maria Corina Machado is advocating for a transition to new leadership by July 2027 to address the country's ongoing economic and political struggles.
amharic: በቬንዙዌላ ባለፉት ሁለት ዓመታት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች ነፃ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ በመጠየቅ አደባባይ ወጥተዋል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ከተያዙ በኋላ፣ ጊዜያዊቷ ፕሬዚዳንት ደልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ ስልጣኑን ቢቆጣጠሩም እስካሁን ምርጫ የሚካሄድበትን ቀን አልወሰኑም። የሃገሪቱ ተቃዋሚ መሪ ማሪያ ኮሪና ማቻዶ በኢኮኖሚ እና በፖለቲካ ቀውስ ውስጥ ላለችው ቬንዙዌላ እስከ ጁላይ 2027 ድረስ አዲስ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ ግፊት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Venezuela keessatti waggoota lama keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman filannoo bilisa ta'e akka geggeeffamu gaafachaa hiriira bahaniiru. Preezidaantiin duraanii Niikolaas Maaduuroo humnoota Ameerikaatiin qabamanii erga biyyaa ba'anii booda, pirezidaantiin yeroo Delisii Rodrigeez aangoorra turus, hanga ammaatti guyyaa filannoo hin murteessine. Hogganaan mormituu Maariyaa Koriinaa Maachaadoo rakkoo dinagdee fi siyaasaa biyyattii furuuf filannoon haaraan akka geggeeffamuufi haala kanaan jijjiirramni akka dhufu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC investigation finds
english: A recent BBC investigation has uncovered evidence that the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) deliberately and systematically targeted healthcare facilities in el-Fasher, Darfur, between 2024 and 2025. The findings reveal that over 40 attacks occurred, resulting in significant casualties among medical staff and the collapse of the city's health system. While UN officials state these actions may constitute war crimes, the RSF has denied the allegations, labeling the report as propaganda.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው በዳርፉር ኤል-ፋሸር ከተማ የነበሩ የሱዳን ፈጣን ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች (RSF) በጤና ተቋማት ላይ ሆን ብለው እና በስርዓት ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በሪፖርቱ መሠረት ከ40 በላይ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በርካታ የህክምና ባለሙያዎችን ለሞት እና ለጉዳት ከመዳረጉም በላይ የከተማዋን የጤና አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ አቋርጧል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የጦር ወንጀል ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ሲገልጹ፣ የRSF አመራር ግን ክሱን በማስተባበል ፕሮፓጋንዳ ነው ብለውታል።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC dhiheenya kana gaggeesse akka mirkaneessetti, gareen waraanaa Sudaan kan RSF jedhamu magaalaa Daarfur, el-Faasher keessatti buufataalee fayyaa irratti beekaa fi karaa sirna qabuun haleellaa raawwateera. Qorannoon kun haleellaawwan 40 ol ta'an raawwatamuusaanii fi kanaanis hojjattoota fayyaa hedduun ajjeefamuu akkasumas sirni fayyaa magaalamtuu guutummaatti diigamuu isaa ibseera. Mootummoonni Gamtooman raawwiin kun yakka waraanaa ta'uu danda'a jechuun yoo himatan, gareen RSF garuu himannaa kana haaluun oduu sobaa fi kijiba jedhee waameera.

title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skin care sales
english: Cosmetics giant L'Oreal has noted that the growing popularity of weight loss medications is affecting the beauty and skincare market. Because rapid weight loss can lead to skin sagging, the company is now focusing on creating products specifically designed to address these aesthetic concerns. L'Oreal is also investing more in clinical dermatology to provide solutions for customers experiencing changes in their facial appearance after using these drugs.
amharic: የውበት መዋቢያ አምራቿ ሎሬል (L'Oreal) ክብደት መቀነሻ መድኃኒቶች በውበት እና በቆዳ እንክብካቤ ምርቶች ፍላጎት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደሩ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ፈጣን የክብደት መቀነስ የቆዳ መለጠጥ እና መሸብሸብን ሊያስከትል ስለሚችል ኩባንያው ለእነዚህ ችግሮች መፍትሄ የሚሆኑ ምርቶችን በማምረት ላይ ትኩረት አድርጓል። በተጨማሪም ሎሬል ተጠቃሚዎች መድኃኒቶቹን በመጠቀም ምክንያት በሚያጋጥማቸው የፊት ገጽታ ለውጥ ላይ ውጤታማ መፍትሄዎችን ለመስጠት በቆዳ ህክምና መስክ ኢንቨስትመንቱን እያሳደገ ነው።
oromo: Hojjettoota miidhaginaa beekamtii qaban kan ta'e L'Oreal, qorichoonni ulfaatina qaamaa hir'isan gabaa miidhaginaa fi kunuunsa gogaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiraachuu beeksiseera. Ulfaatina qaamaa ariitiin hir'isuun gogaa gadi buusuu waan danda'uuf, dhaabbatichi rakkoo kana furuuf jecha oomishaalee addaa qopheessaa jira. Kana malees, L'Oreal namoonni qorichoota kana fayyadaman booda jijjiirama fuula isaanii irratti mul'atuuf furmaata kennuuf, damee yaala gogaa (dermatology) irratti investimentii isaa dabalaa jira.

title: Tibet rocked by 7.0-magnitude earthquake
english: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake recently struck the Tibet region in southwestern China, causing significant destruction. The disaster has resulted in the loss of at least 16 lives. This event marks the most intense seismic activity recorded in China since the beginning of 2024.
amharic: የ7.0 ማግኒቱድ መጠን ያለው ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በደቡብ ምዕራብ ቻይና በቲቤት ክልል ላይ ደርሷል። በዚህ አደጋ ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ይህ ክስተት ከ2024 መጀመሪያ አንስቶ በቻይና የተመዘገበው እጅግ ከፍተኛው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ነው።
oromo: ጂኦሎጂካል ፕሌት 7.0 kan ta'e sochiin lafaa cimaan tokko naannoo Tibet kan kibba-lixaa Chaayinaatti argamutti mudateera. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 16 ol ta'anii darbeera. Sochiin lafaa kun erga bara 2024 jalqabee biyyattii keessatti kan mudate isa hunda caalaa cimaa dha.

title: Iran war live: Trump hints new strikes, says US knocked ‘hell out’ of Iran
english: President Donald Trump has suggested that the United States may launch additional military strikes against Iran, claiming the U.S. has already inflicted significant damage. This warning follows a major incident in the Strait of Hormuz, where seven oil tankers were damaged in a single day. The event represents a notable escalation in the ongoing conflict between the U.S.-Israel coalition and Iran.

oromo: Pirezedaantiin Doolard Tiraamp ammaan booda tarkaanfiin waraanaa Itoophiyaa irra darbee Iran irratti fudhatamuu danda’u akka jiru eeraniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga markaboonni boba’aa torba galaana Ormuz keessatti miidhamanii boodadha. Taatee kun walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaa fi Israa’el giddutti adeemsifamuun Iran irratti taasifamu daran jabaachaa akka jiru argisiisa.

title: UK Conservative Party leader responds to Al Jazeera investigation
english: UK Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch has publicly condemned the actions of Jack Ross, a former party member and candidate. This response follows an Al Jazeera investigation that exposed Ross discussing hired assassins and his involvement in connecting a far-right activist to others. The party has officially distanced itself from his controversial conduct.

oromo: Hogganaan Paartii Konservativii UK Keemii Baadeenook, miseensa paartichaa duraanii fi kaadhimamaa ture Jaak Roos gocha inni raawwate balaaleffataniiru. Qorannoon Al Jazeera akka ibsetti, Jaak Roos namoota ajjeesuudhaaf nama qacaruu fi sochii garee mirga-duree waliin walqabatu irratti hirmaachuun isaa saaxilameera. Paartiin kun gocha roos kun fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu fi ofirraa qabuusaa ibseera.

title: Hundreds of Ethiopians cross into Kenya to flee regional fighting
english: Hundreds of Ethiopian citizens, primarily women and children, have sought refuge in Kenya following violent clashes in the border town of Moyale. The unrest was triggered by a dispute over the display of a regional flag, leading to fighting between forces from the Oromia and Somali regions. The Kenya Red Cross is currently providing emergency shelter and supplies to the displaced families as they assess the situation.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ሞያሌ ከተማ በተቀሰቀሰ ግጭት ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ሴቶችና ህፃናት፣ ወደ ኬንያ ተሰደዋል። ግጭቱ የተቀሰቀሰው በአካባቢው ክልል ሰንደቅ ዓላማ አሰቃቀር ላይ በተነሳ አለመግባባት በኦሮሚያ እና በሶማሌ ክልል ኃይሎች መካከል በተፈጠረ ውጥረት ነው። የኬንያ ቀይ መስቀል ማህበር ለተፈናቃዮቹ መጠለያ እና አስፈላጊ የምግብ ቁሳቁሶችን በማቅረብ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Godina aanaa Moyyaaleetti walitti buiinsa uumameen walqabatee, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman, keessattuu dubartoonniifi ijoolleen, gara biyya Keeniyaatti baqatan. Walitti bu'insi kun kan ka'e alaabaa naannoo tokko ol kaasuun walqabatee humnoota naannoo Oromiyaafi naannoo Sumaale gidduutti erga uumamee booda. Waldaan Fannoo Diimaa Keeniyaas namoota baqatan kanaaf iddoo qubataafi gargaarsa nyaataa dhiheessuuf hojjataa jira.

title: Trump says Musk has restored Ukraine's access after Starlink row
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that Elon Musk has restored full Starlink internet access to Ukraine following a period of restricted speeds that hindered military operations. While President Volodymyr Zelensky noted that full service had not yet been completely recovered as of Thursday, reports suggest a private conversation between Trump and Musk led to the lifting of these connectivity limits. This situation highlights the critical dependence of the Ukrainian military on Musk's satellite technology for battlefield communications and drone operations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ ኢሎን ማስክ የዩክሬን የስታርሊንክ ኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ መመለሱን አረጋግጠዋል። በዩክሬን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሮ የነበረው የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት መገደብ፣ በትራምፕ እና በማስክ መካከል በተደረገ ውይይት እንደተፈታ ይነገራል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ አገልግሎቱ ገና ሙሉ በሙሉ አልተመለሰም ቢሉም፣ ይህ ክስተት የዩክሬን ጦር ለጦር ሜዳ ግንኙነት እና ለድሮን ስራዎች በስታርሊንክ ቴክኖሎጂ ላይ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጥገኝነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Traamp, Elon Maaski tajaajila interneetii Staarlinkii kan Yuukreeniif deebisee guutuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Dhibbaan ariitii interneetii kun tarkaanfii waraana Yuukreen irratti gufuu ta'ee kan ture yoo ta'u, marii Traampii fi Maaski gidduutti godhame kanaan akka furame himama. Pireezidaanti Vooloodiimiir Zelenski tajaajilli sun ammayyuu guutummaatti hin deebine jedhanii ibsanillee, taateen kun waraanni Yuukreen qunnamtii dirree waraanaa fi hojii dooniiwwan (drones) isaanii geggeessuuf teeknoolojii Staarlinkii irratti hangam akka hirkatan agarsiisa.

title: Ecuador opposition leader Luisa Gonzalez arrested in campaign finance probe
english: Luisa Gonzalez, an Ecuadorian opposition leader and former presidential candidate, was arrested on charges related to illegal campaign financing during her 2023 election bid. Authorities suspect that about $500,000 was moved through an unauthorized network of entities to hide the true source of campaign funds. Gonzalez and her political movement have denied these allegations, labeling the arrest as a form of political persecution by the current government.
amharic: የኢኳዶር የተቃዋሚ መሪ እና የቀድሞ የፕሬዚዳንት እጩ ሉዊሳ ጎንዛሌዝ እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ወቅት በተፈጸመ የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ታሰሩ። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ወደ 500,000 የሚጠጋ የአሜሪካ ዶላር የገንዘብ ምንጩን ለመደበቅ ባልተፈቀደ መንገድ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል። ጎንዛሌዝ እና የፖለቲካ ድርጅታቸው ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ እስሩ በአሁኑ መንግስት የተቃጣባቸው የፖለቲካ አድማ ነው ሲሉ ኮንነዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun mormituu Ikuwaadoor fi dursee dorgomtuun pireezidaantummaa duraanii Luwiisaa Goonzaaleez, xalayaa filannoo ishee kan bara 2023 irratti shakkii seeraan alaa maallaqa fayyadamuu irratti to'ataman. Abbootiin alangaa akka jedhanitti, qarshiin gara kuma 500 ta'u maddasaa dhoksuuf jecha karaa seeraan alaa ta'een akka socho'e shakkameera. Goonzaaleez fi dhaabbanni siyaasaa ishee himannicha haaluun, hidhichi mootummaa amma jiruun siyaasaa irratti xiyyeeffatee kan gaggeeffame akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Michigan voters closely divided between Rogers and El-Sayed
english: As the midterm elections approach, voters in Michigan remain split between Republican candidate Mike Rogers and Democrat Abdul El-Sayed for the U.S. Senate seat. Recent campaign activities highlight the tight competition between the two contenders. Some voters have raised personal questions regarding the candidates during public events, reflecting the intense atmosphere of this race.

oromo: Filannoon giddu-galeessa waggaa dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, filattoonni Michigan teessoo Mana Maree Senetii Amerikaatiif giddutti kan dorgoman Mike Rogers kan paartii Rippabilikaanii fi Abdul El-Sayed kan paartii Dimookiraataatii gidduutti qooddamaniru. title: What is the history behind Trump’s LeBron blast over US national anthem?
english: President Donald Trump recently criticized NBA star LeBron James for continuing his pre-game warm-ups during the playing of the national anthem. Trump labeled the athlete a disgrace and demanded an apology, citing a lack of respect for American heroes. This incident is the latest in a long-standing history of public friction between the two figures, who have frequently traded political criticisms over the years.

title: Magnitude 7 earthquake kills 16 people in China’s Tibet, Xinhua reports
english: A powerful magnitude 7 earthquake struck China's Tibet region, resulting in at least 16 deaths and 32 injuries. Emergency teams have launched a level-II response as many residents fled their homes for safety due to structural damage. This event marks the most intense seismic activity recorded in China since the beginning of 2024.

title: First Arab-American mayor to endorse Trump becomes adviser to president
english: Amer Ghalib, the former mayor of Hamtramck, Michigan, has been appointed as President Trump’s advisor for Arab-American affairs. Ghalib, who gained national attention as the first Arab and Muslim official to endorse Trump in 2024, will serve as a direct liaison between the White House and the community. Although his previous nomination as ambassador to Kuwait was blocked by the Senate due to past social media comments, he will now provide informal policy advice to the President.

title: Egypt calls for Yemen talks as parliament weighs military support to Saudi Arabia
english: Egypt is advocating for diplomatic solutions to the conflict in Yemen while its parliament considers whether to authorize military support for Saudi Arabia against Houthi forces. Lawmakers have delayed the final vote until late October to allow for further discussion on the matter. Egyptian officials have also traveled to Riyadh to consult with Saudi leadership regarding the potential military involvement.

english: Syrian officials reported that Israeli military forces killed a disabled civilian during a raid in the Daraa province on Thursday. The operation involved an initial bombing followed by soldiers positioning themselves on rooftops within the village of Jamla. The Syrian government has formally condemned the attack, labeling it a violation of international law and a threat to regional stability.

title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
english: Premature twins Raghad and Raad are fighting for their lives in a Yemeni hospital after their family was forced to flee their home due to intensified civil war. The infants suffered from severe malnutrition after their family spent days traveling on foot to escape dangerous fighting. This tragedy highlights a broader crisis in Yemen, where escalating conflict has displaced hundreds of thousands of people and severely disrupted access to essential humanitarian aid and food.

title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
english: A US judge has ruled that Donald Trump must provide sworn testimony by December 11 as part of his defamation lawsuit against the BBC. The legal dispute stems from a BBC documentary that Trump claims deceptively edited his 2021 speech regarding the Capitol riot. While Trump’s team argued for a later date due to his schedule, the court has mandated the deposition proceed within the current discovery timeline.

title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest

This incident highlights ongoing security concerns in Germany, which has seen multiple arrests related to foreign spying activities since increasing its military support for Ukraine.

title: Time just changed forever

amharic: የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ለጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በቀጣዩ የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ የሚኖረውን ድጋፍ እስካሁን በይፋ አልገለጸም። ኢንፋንቲኖ ለስድስተኛ ጊዜ ለስልጣን በሚወዳደሩበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የ47ቱ የእስያ አገራት ድምፅ ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖረዋል። የኮንፌዴሬሽኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ሼክ ሳልማን ድርጅታቸው በአሁኑ ሰዓት ገለልተኛ መሆኑን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ አባል አገራቱ ግን በተለያዩ አቋሞች ተከፋፍለዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Kubbaa Miilaa Eeshiyaa (AFC) deeggarsa isaa kanneen filannoo pireezidaantummaa FIFA itti aanuuf jiruuf Gianni Infantino-f hanga ammaatti hin ibsine. Infantino yeroo afuraffaaf aangoo barbaadaa jiru kanatti, biyyoonni miseensa AFC 47 ta'an sagalee murteessaa qabu, ta'us yaanni miseensota gidduutti wal qabataa miti. title: Tsadkan’s “Reforms” Have Fragmented Tigray’s Unity
english: The political campaign led by General Tsadkan Gebretensae and his allies to weaken the TPLF has fractured Tigray's internal unity rather than solving the region's humanitarian crisis. By aligning with federal forces to dismantle existing political institutions, this faction has deepened regional divisions and renewed old internal grievances. Instead of achieving the stability promised by the Pretoria Agreement, these actions have left the people of Tigray struggling with ongoing trauma and a lack of recovery.

oromo: Duulli siyaasaa kan jeneraal Tsadqaan Gabratinsa'eefi degartootasaatiin durfamu, kan laaftuu TPLF laaffisuuf yaadame, tokkummaa naannoo Tigraay kan cimsineefii mannaa qooddeera. Gareen kun humnoota federaalaa wajjin hiriiruun jaarmiyaalee siyaasaa naannichaa diiguuf yaaluunsaanii, mufiiwwan durii fi wal dhabdee keessa deebi'ee akka uumamu godheera. Waliigalteen nagaa Preetoriyaa abdii gaarii kan fide ta'us, dorgommii siyaasaa kanatu nagaa fi misooma ummataa gufuu ta'ee, rakkina sabichaa caalaatti hammaachiiseera.

title: How Arab parties could hold critical balance of power in Israeli election
english: In the upcoming Israeli election, Arab parties are positioned as potential kingmakers as the race remains deadlocked between opposing coalitions. Many Arab citizens are highly motivated to vote this time to challenge the current hard-line government, despite facing increased social tension and discrimination since the October 7 attacks. While major Jewish political blocs have historically hesitated to form alliances with Arab parties, the lack of a clear majority may force them to reconsider these partnerships to secure power.

oromo: Filannoo Israaʼel dhufuuf jiru keessatti, partileen Arabaa mormitoota jidduu qixa taʼuun murteessitoota taʼuu dandaʼu. Lammiileen Arabaa hedduun, haala siyaasaa cimaa ammaa dura dhaabachuuf filannoo irratti hirmaachuuf fedhii guddaa qabu. title: Celebrity shark guided out of South Korea canal refuses to swim out to sea
english: A famous dusky shark named Bukangi, which became a local celebrity in the South Korean city of Busan, is refusing to leave a canal despite a lengthy rescue effort. After authorities spent hours guiding the shark toward the open sea, the animal repeatedly circled back and even broke through barriers to return to the waterway. Experts believe the shark may be attracted to the canal due to warmer water temperatures and a steady food supply, though concerns remain regarding its health.
amharic: ቡካንጊ የተባለችው ታዋቂ የሻርክ ዓሣ በደቡብ ኮሪያዋ ቡሳን ከተማ የሚገኝ ቦይ ለቅቃ ወደ ባህር ለመሄድ ፈቃደኛ አልሆነችም። ባለሥልጣናት የሻርክ ዓሣዋን ወደ ሰፊው ባህር ለመመለስ ለረጅም ሰዓታት ጥረት ቢያደርጉም፣ እንስሳቷ በተደጋጋሚ ወደ ቦዩ እየተመለሰች ትገኛለች። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚሉት የውኃው ሙቀት መጨመርና የምግብ መኖር ዓሣዋን ወደ ቦዩ እንደሳባት ቢገመትም፣ ስለ ጤንነቷ አሳሳቢ ሁኔታዎች አሁንም አሉ።
oromo: Qirixxiin (shark) beekamtii argate kan Bukangi jedhamu, magaalaa Busaan kan Koriyaa Kibbaa keessatti toora bishaanii keessatti hafeera. Ogeeyyonni qirixxiicha gara galaanaatti deebisuuf sa'aatii dheeraaf carraaqqii godhanis, inni garuu irra deddeebi'ee gara toora bishaanii sanatti deebi'aa jira. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, ho'i bishaanii fi nyaanni toora bishaanii san keessatti argamu qirixxiicha akka harkise yaadamu, ta'us fayyummaan isaa ammas yaaddoo keessa jira.

title: Two killed in attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
english: An attack at King Fahd International Airport in eastern Saudi Arabia resulted in two deaths and eight injuries among various nationalities. While officials have not specified the method of the attack, it follows a series of drone and missile strikes in the region often attributed to Houthi rebels. The incident is part of an escalating conflict involving cross-border hostilities between Saudi-led forces and Houthi fighters.

title: El Salvador's president threatens Haitian gangs over military hostages
english: El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele has launched a military rescue operation to save four air force members kidnapped by armed gangs in Haiti. The personnel, who were part of a UN-authorized security force, were ambushed while buying food and are currently being held hostage. President Bukele has issued a stern warning to the captors, promising severe consequences if the individuals are not returned unharmed.

title: Michigan Senate debate: Key takeaways from El-Sayed, Rogers clash
english: Michigan Senate candidates Abdul El-Sayed and Mike Rogers held their final debate ahead of the upcoming midterm elections, focusing on issues like trade, foreign policy, and the economy. Rogers discussed the impact of tariffs on Michigan’s automotive industry, while El-Sayed criticized his opponent's stance on the conflict with Iran. The outcome of this race is critical, as it will help determine which party gains control of the U.S. Senate.

Haleellaa kana hordofee magaalaawwan Kiiyivii fi Moskoo keessatti namoonni hedduun miidhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun haala waraana biyyoota lamaanii fi carraa marii nagaa irratti gaaffii guddaa uumaa jira.

title: Brazil’s president appeals to undecided voters ahead of run-off
english: As Brazil’s presidential election heads into a decisive final round, candidates Lula and Bolsonaro are aggressively campaigning to win over the 30 million people who did not participate in the first round. Both leaders are focusing their efforts on persuading these undecided or abstaining voters in key regions. This final push is critical as the candidates compete to secure the presidency in the upcoming Sunday vote.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ወደ ወሳኙ የመጨረሻ ዙር እየተቃረበ ባለበት ወቅት፣ እጩዎቹ ሉላ እና ቦልሶናሮ በመጀመሪያው ዙር ድምፅ ያልሰጡትን 30 ሚሊዮን መራጮች ለማሳመን ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ሁለቱም መሪዎች በአስፈላጊ ወረዳዎች ውስጥ ያሉትን እነዚህን አሻሚ ወይም ድምፅ ያልሰጡ መራጮች ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ትኩረት ሰጥተዋል። እሁድ በሚካሄደው የመጨረሻ ምርጫ አሸናፊውን ለመለየት ይህ የመጨረሻ የቅስቀሳ ሂደት ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidaantummaa biyya Brazil gara maroo dhumaa murteessaa ta'eetti yeroo ce'utti, kaadhimamtoonni Lula fi Bolsonaro namoota miliyoona 30 filannoo jalqabaa irratti hirmaachuu hin dandeenye of biratti hiriirsuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Hogganoonni lamaanuu naannolee murteessaa ta'an keessatti namoota sagalee hin kennine kana amansiisuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennaniiru. Qophiin kun guyyaa Dilbataa filannoo dhufuuf jiru irratti eenyu akka mo'atu murteessuuf baay'ee barbaachisaadha.

title: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
english: Major global websites and government services have been taken offline to address critical security vulnerabilities discovered in the PHP programming language. These severe flaws, identified by artificial intelligence, pose a significant threat as they could allow unauthorized access to sensitive server data. International agencies are advising organizations to either apply the emergency security update immediately or suspend their websites until the risks are fully mitigated.
amharic: በ PHP የፕሮግራም አወጣጥ ቋንቋ ላይ በተገኙ አደገኛ የደህንነት ጉድለቶች ምክንያት በርካታ አለም አቀፍ ድረ-ገጾች እና የመንግስት አገልግሎቶች ተቋርጠዋል። በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የተገኙት እነዚህ ከባድ ችግሮች፣ ጠላፊዎች ወደ አገልጋይ ፋይሎች እና ዳታቤዞች በቀላሉ እንዲገቡ ሊያደርጉ ስለሚችሉ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። የሳይበር ደህንነት ተቋማት ድርጅቶች አስቸኳይ የደህንነት ማሻሻያዎችን እንዲያደርጉ ወይም ችግሩ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ድረ-ገጾቻቸውን እንዲዘጉ እያሳሰቡ ነው።
oromo: Hojiin dhimmoota internetii fi websayitoota biyyoolessaa hedduun, rakkoo nageenyaa cimaa afaan sagantaa PHP keessatti argamee hordofee addaan citeera. Rakkoon kun kan argame gargaarsa 'Artificial Intelligence' tiin yoo ta'u, namoonni seeraan ala odeeffannoo dhokataa serverii irraa akka hatan waan taasisuuf balaa guddaa dha. Dhaabbileen nageenya sayibarii addunyaa guutuu, qaamoleen internetii akkaataa suphamaa hatattamaa kana akka fudhatanii fi yoo hin danda'amne ammoo websayitoota isaanii yeroof akka cufan gorsa kennaa jiru.

title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
english: Researchers recently used artificial intelligence to discover a severe, long-standing security vulnerability in the PHP programming language, which powers a significant portion of the internet. Because this flaw allows hackers to potentially take control of web servers and steal sensitive information, governments and major organizations have been forced to take sites offline or install emergency patches. Experts warn that millions of websites are at risk, making this one of the most critical security alerts in recent memory.
amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በቅርቡ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን በመጠቀም በ PHP ፕሮግራሚንግ ቋንቋ ውስጥ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲያገለግል የቆየ ከባድ የደህንነት ጉድለት አግኝተዋል። ይህ ክፍተት ጠላፊዎች የድር አገልጋዮችን ተቆጣጥረው ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን እንዳይሰርቁ ስጋት ስለፈጠረ፣ መንግስታት እና ዋና ዋና ተቋማት ድረ-ገጾቻቸውን እንዲዘጉ ወይም አስቸኳይ ማስተካከያዎችን እንዲያደርጉ ተገደዋል። በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ድረ-ገጾች ለአደጋ የተጋለጡ በመሆናቸው፣ ይህ ጉዳይ በቅርብ ጊዜ ውስጥ ከተከሰቱት እጅግ አደገኛ የሳይበር ደህንነት ስጋቶች አንዱ ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Qorattoonni yeroo dhihoo asii fayyadamni 'artificial intelligence' koodii PHP jedhamu keessatti rakkoo nageenyaa cimaa fi yeroo dheeraaf ture akka jiru ifoomsuu danda'aniiru. Rakkoon kun buttonni interneetii qabachuu fi odeeffannoo dhokataa hatuu akka danda'aniif karaa banuudhaan, mootummoonni fi dhaabbileen gurguddoon marsariitiiwwan isaanii yeroof akka cufan ykn furmaata ariifataa akka fudhatan dirqisiiseera. Marsariitiiwwan miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman balaa kanaaf saaxilamuu isaanii kan ibsu ta'uun, kunis rakkoo nageenyaa interneetii yeroo dhihoo asitti mudate keessaa isa cimaa ta'uu himameera.

title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
english: The United States has instructed non-essential government employees and their families to exit Saudi Arabia due to an increase in Houthi militant attacks. Hostilities from the Iran-backed group have targeted civilian infrastructure, including airports and oil facilities, leading to several deaths and injuries. The State Department issued this directive out of concern that the ongoing violence could worsen rapidly.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ አሜሪካ አስፈላጊ ያልሆኑ የመንግስት ሰራተኞቿ እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ሀገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አዛለች። ኢራን የምትደግፋቸው ታጣቂዎች በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች፣ በአየር ማረፊያዎች እና በነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ በፈጸሙት ጥቃት የሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል፤ ሌሎችም ቆስለዋል። የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መስሪያ ቤት ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ግጭቱ በፍጥነት ሊባባስ ይችላል በሚል ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጿል።
oromo: Humni waraanaa Huutii kan gara Iranitti qabatu miidhaa isaa gadi jabeessuun hordofee, mootummaan Ameerikaa hojjettoota mootummaa kanneen dirqama idilee hin qabne fi maatiin isaanii Sa'udii Arabiyaa akka gadhiisan ajajee jira. Haleellaa gareen kun buufata xiyyaaraa fi iddoowwan damee boba'aa irratti raawwataniin lubbuun namootaa darbee miidhaanis ga'eera. Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa Ameerikaa akka jedhetti, tarkiinichi kan fudhatame waraanni kun saffisaan hammatuufi soda jiruufi.

title: El-Sayed in face-off against rival Rogers for Michigan Senate seat
english: Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers recently participated in their final debate for an open US Senate seat in Michigan. During the event, the candidates were asked to share their perspectives on whether Iran represents a significant threat to American national security. This debate served as a key opportunity for the two rivals to present their platforms to voters before the election.
amharic: የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ እና የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲው ማይክ ሮጀርስ በሚቺጋን ክፍት የዩኤስ ሴኔት መቀመጫ ላይ ለመወዳደር በመጨረሻው ክርክር ተሳትፈዋል። በክርክሩ ወቅት እጩዎቹ ኢራን በአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ትፈጥራለች ወይ በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ያላቸውን አቋም እንዲገልጹ ተጠይቀዋል። ይህ ክርክር ሁለቱ ተቀናቃኞች ከመምረጣቸው በፊት ለምርጫው የሚያቀርቡትን ዕቅድ ለሕዝብ ለማስተዋወቅ ትልቅ ዕድል ፈጥሮላቸዋል።
oromo: Hirmaattonni paartii Dimokiraatawaa Abdul El-Sayed fi paartii Rippabilikaanaa Maayik Rojars kursiifi mana maree senetii Miishigan irratti dorgomuuf falmii isaanii isa dhumaa geggeessaniiru. Falmii kana irratti, dorgomtoonni kunniin Iran nageenya biyyoolessaa Ameerikaa irratti balaa qabaachuu ishee ilaalchisee yaada isaanii akka ibsan gaafatamaniiru. Falmiin kun dorgomtoota lamaan kun sagalee kennitootaatti dhiyaachuu fi yaada isaanii ifatti ibsachuuf carraa guddaa ta'eera.

title: North Korea to resume propaganda broadcasts, South Korea urges dialogue
english: North Korea plans to restart anti-South Korea propaganda broadcasts along their border, further escalating tensions after a recent landmine incident injured South Korean soldiers. Kim Yo Jong warned of harsh consequences and announced that new military measures are being prepared at the frontier. Meanwhile, South Korea has officially called for direct talks to prevent accidental military clashes, despite the North refusing to engage in dialogue.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ በደቡብ ኮሪያ ድንበር ላይ የፕሮፓጋንዳ ስርጭቶችን እንደገና ለመጀመር ማቀዷን አስታውቃለች፤ ይህም በቅርቡ በተከሰተው የማዕድን ፍንዳታ ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል። የሰሜን ኮሪያዋ ባለስልጣን ኪም ዮ ጆንግ በድንበሩ ላይ አዳዲስ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እንደሚወሰዱ በማስጠንቀቅ ለደቡብ ኮሪያ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ደቡብ ኮሪያ ማንኛውንም አይነት ወታደራዊ ግጭት ለመከላከል እንዲቻል በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ውይይት እንዲደረግ ጥሪ አቅርባለች።
oromo: Koreeaan Kaabaa daangaa ishee fi Koreeaan Kibbaa gidduutti duula sagantaa propagandaa ishee ammas itti fufuuf qophii gochuu ishee beeksisteetti. Kunis walitti bu'iinsa uumamee ture kan ammas dabalate yoo ta'u, qondaalti biyyattii Kim Yo Jong tarkaanfii waraanaa haaraa fudhachuu akka malu akeekkachiisteetti. Gama biraatiin, Koreeaan Kibbaa walitti bu'iinsa tasaa ta'e hambisuuf mariin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti akka taasifamu gaafatteetti.

title: Brazil’s Bolsonaro challenges Lula to expand release of personal records
english: Ahead of Brazil's upcoming presidential runoff, candidates Flavio Bolsonaro and President Lula have engaged in a dispute over the disclosure of personal financial and communication records. Lula initially offered to release his private data if Bolsonaro did the same, leading Bolsonaro to demand that the president also include records from his staff and children. Lula has reportedly agreed to these expanded terms, aiming to clear his name amidst ongoing corruption investigations involving both political camps.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ እየተቃረበ ባለበት ወቅት፣ ተወዳዳሪዎቹ ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ እና ፕሬዝዳንት ሉላ የግል የገንዘብ እና የመገናኛ መረጃዎቻቸውን ይፋ በማድረግ ላይ ተከራክረዋል። ሉላ የራሳቸውን መረጃ ይፋ እንደሚያደርጉ ቢገልጹም፣ ቦልሶናሮ በተጨማሪም የፕሬዝዳንቱ አማካሪዎችና የልጆቻቸው መረጃ እንዲካተት ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ሉላ በሁለቱም ወገኖች ላይ እየተካሄደ ባለው የሙስና ምርመራ ወቅት ግልጽነትን ለማሳየት ይህንን መስፈርት ተቀብለዋል።
oromo: Filannoo prezidaantummaa Birazil kan itti aanuuf qophiirra jirru kanatti, dorgomtoonni Flavio Bolsonaro fi Prezidaant Lula ragaalee dhuunfaa isaanii ifa gochuurratti wal mormaniiru. Lula ragaalee dhuunfaa isaa ifa gochuuf fedhii kan agarsiise yoo ta'u, Bolsonaro garuu ragaaleen gorsitoota prezidaantichaa fi ijoollee isaa akka dabalaman gaafateera. Prezidaant Lulaan, himannaa malaammaltummaa gam lamaanuu irratti banamee jiru keessatti iftoomina uumuuf jecha, gaaffii Bolsonaro kana fudhateera.

title: Australian TV reporter rescues man from sinking car
english: While covering the severe flooding in Queensland, Australia, a journalist named Will Murray stepped in to help. He and another local resident successfully pulled a man to safety after his vehicle became stuck and started sinking in deep water. Both rescuers acted quickly to save the driver before the situation worsened.

english: A Canadian publisher, Boreal, has ended its partnership with author Thelyson Orelien after confirming that AI was used to write his successful novel, It Was Either That or Die. Consequently, the book has been removed from prestigious literary prize lists, despite the author's prior insistence that he only utilized technology for minor research purposes.
